latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — provides real-time search tools for safety recalls and consumer complaints:

- Search NHTSA vehicle recalls by make, model, and year.
- Find FDA recalls for drugs, food, and medical devices.
- Search CFPB consumer complaints about financial companies.
- No API keys required; all data from free US government sources.
- Quick setup instructions and example use cases included.
